name: B10-0513/2025 (S&D) – Political situation in Myanmar including the humanitarian crisis of the Rohingya
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the political situation in Myanmar including the humanitarian crisis of the Rohingya
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly criticises Myanmar's military junta for violence against civilians, including airstrikes, forced conscription, torture and sexual violence. It condemns the suffering of the Rohingya minority, who are stateless and trapped by fighting. It calls for safe humanitarian access across the country, protection for refugees in neighbouring countries, and release of detained leaders and political prisoners. It rejects the junta's planned December 2025 elections as neither free nor fair, and asks the EU to impose targeted sanctions on military leaders. This is a statement of the Parliament's position; it does not itself change any law.

- The Parliament calls for targeted EU sanctions on junta leaders and their economic backers.
- Millions of displaced people and Rohingya communities would benefit from demanded aid access.
- The EU and ASEAN are urged to press the junta to end violence and hand back power.
